hooks.name: Repo safety guard
hooks.description: After saving .gitignore or any .env file, checks that .kiro is not ignored and that no real .env file is tracked.

action.prompt: Repo safety guard. .gitignore or an .env file was saved. Run two read-only checks and report each as OK or WARNING. (1) `git check-ignore .kiro` must print nothing. If it prints a path, warn loudly that .kiro is ignored, which breaks the rule that .kiro is always committed. (2) `git ls-files '.env*'` must list only .env.example. If any other .env file is tracked, warn loudly that a real key may be committed, that it must be removed from git with `git rm --cached` and that the key must be rotated. Never open, print or quote the contents of a real .env file. Read-only: do not edit, create or save any file, and do not run git add, git rm or git commit.
